commands:
set -eu
ROOT="$HOME/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/work"
WT="$HOME/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/worktrees/unified-ux-20261104-v1"
echo "ROOT_BRANCH=$(git -C "$ROOT" branch --show-current)"
echo "ROOT_SHA=$(git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse HEAD)"
echo "ROOT_DIRTY=$(git -C "$ROOT" status --porcelain | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
echo "WT_BRANCH=$(git -C "$WT" branch --show-current)"
echo "WT_SHA=$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse HEAD)"
echo "WT_DIRTY=$(git -C "$WT" status --porcelain | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
git -C "$ROOT" worktree list
echo RELEASE_WORKTREE_PREFLIGHT_READONLY
